```{r}
rm(list = ls())
# Kerakli paketlarni chaqiramiz library(tidyverse) library(httr) library(jsonlite)f library(readxl) library(gt)
# Kerakli barcha paketlarni chaqiramiz
library(tidyverse)
library(httr) # <--- Mana shu qator GET() funksiyasini yuklaydi
library(jsonlite)
library(readxl)
library(gt)
#--- LOYIHA SOZLAMALARI ---

kobo_data <- readRDS("kobo_data.rds")
child_table_name <- "hh_member" 

#asset_uid <- "aNaY8Pr5dLFox6Ebctkk2b" 
#child_table_name <- "hh_member" # XLSForm dagi takrorlanuvchi guruh nomi

#--- 1. MA'LUMOTLARNI YUKLASH ---

#kobo_token <- Sys.getenv("KOBO_TOKEN") 
#api_url <- paste0("https://kf.kobotoolbox.org/api/v2/assets/", asset_uid, "/data.json") 
#response <- GET(url = api_url, add_headers(Authorization = paste("Token", kobo_token)))
#stop_for_status(response)
#kobo_data <- fromJSON(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), flatten = FALSE)$results



#--- 2. JADAVLLARNI AJRATISH ---

household_raw <- kobo_data %>% select(-all_of(child_table_name)) 

temp_for_unnest <- kobo_data[c("_uuid", child_table_name)]
hh_members_raw <- temp_for_unnest %>%
  unnest(all_of(child_table_name), names_sep = "/")

# --- 3. NOMLARNI LUG'ATLAR YORDAMIDA O'ZGARTIRISH ---
dict_household <- read_excel("nomlar_lugati_household.xlsx") %>% filter(!is.na(yangi_nom))
rename_vec_hh <- setNames(dict_household$eski_nom, dict_household$yangi_nom)
household_clean <- household_raw %>% rename(any_of(rename_vec_hh))

dict_hh_members <- read_excel("nomlar_lugati_hh_members.xlsx") %>% filter(!is.na(yangi_nom))
rename_vec_members <- setNames(dict_hh_members$eski_nom, dict_hh_members$yangi_nom)
hh_members_clean <- hh_members_raw %>% rename(any_of(rename_vec_members))


library(gt) # Chiroyli jadvallar uchun

household_clean <- household_clean %>%
  mutate(
    district_name = case_when(
      district == 1  ~ "Конимех тумани",
      district == 2  ~ "Қизилтепа тумани",
      district == 3  ~ "Навбаҳор тумани",
      district == 4  ~ "Кармана тумани",
      district == 5  ~ "Нурота тумани",
      district == 6  ~ "Томди тумани",
      district == 7  ~ "Учқудуқ тумани",
      district == 8  ~ "Хатирчи тумани",
      district == 9  ~ "Навоий шаҳри",
      district == 10  ~ "Зарафшон шаҳри",
      district == 11  ~ "Ғозғон шаҳри",
      .default = as.character(district)
    ),  # <-- MUHIM: Birinchi ustun ta'rifi tugagach, VERGUL

    aholi_punkti = case_when(
      punkt == 1 ~ "Shahar",
      punkt == 2 ~ "Qishloq"
    ),  # <-- MUHIM: Ikkinchi ustun ta'rifi tugagach, VERGUL

    sozlashuv_tili = case_when(
      family_language == '_' ~ "Ўзбек",
      family_language == '__1' ~ "Тожик",
      family_language == '__2' ~ "Қозоқ",
      family_language == '__3' ~ "Қирғиз",
      family_language == '__4' ~ "Қорақалпоқ",
      family_language == '__5' ~ "Рус",
      family_language == '__6' ~ "Бошқа"
    ) # <-- Eng oxirgi ustundan keyin vergul shart emas
  )

daily_submissions <- household_clean %>%
  
  # `submission_time` ustuni sana va vaqtni o'z ichiga oladi.
  # Bizga faqat sana qismi kerak, shuning uchun as.Date() funksiyasidan foydalanamiz.
  mutate(topshirilgan_sana = as.Date(`_submission_time`)) %>%
  
  # Har bir sana bo'yicha qatorlar sonini (ya'ni so'rovnomalar sonini) sanaymiz
  count(topshirilgan_sana, name = "sorovnomalar_soni") %>%
  
  # Natijani sana bo'yicha tartiblaymiz
  arrange(topshirilgan_sana)

# 2-qadam: Grafikni chizamiz
ggplot(daily_submissions, aes(x = topshirilgan_sana, y = sorovnomalar_soni)) +
  
  # Ustunli diagramma (bar chart). `geom_col` oldindan hisoblangan qiymatlar uchun ishlatiladi.
  geom_col(fill = "#659965", width = 0.7) +
  
  # Har bir ustunning ustiga aniq sonini yozib qo'yish (ixtiyoriy)
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sorovnomalar_soni),
    vjust = -0.5, # Matnni ustundan biroz yuqoriga chiqarish
    color = "black",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  # Trendni yaxshiroq ko'rsatish uchun chiziq va nuqtalarni qo'shamiz (ixtiyoriy)
  geom_line(color = "#E67E22", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#E67E22", size = 2) +
  
  # Sana o'qini (x-axis) chiroyli formatlaymiz
  # Agar sanalar ko'p bo'lsa, `date_breaks = "2 days"` yoki `"1 week"` qilib o'zgartirishingiz mumkin
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  
  # Sarlavhalar
  labs(
    title = "Kunlik Topshirilgan So'rovnomalar Dinamikasi",
    x = "Sana",
    y = "Topshirilgan so'rovnomalar soni"
  ) +
  
  # Orqa fon va umumiy ko'rinish
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  # Agar sana yozuvlari bir-biriga kirishib ketsa, ularni 45 darajaga qiyalashtiramiz
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


household_clean %>%
  count(district_name, sort = TRUE, name = "Уй хўжаликлари сони") %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Туманлар кесимида сўровда қатнашган уй хўжаликлари сони"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center")

household_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(district_name)) %>% # NA qiymatlarni filtrlaymiz
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(fct_infreq(district_name)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#659961") + # Ustunlarni chizamiz va legenda (ranglar izohi)ni yashiramiz
  
  # Har bir ustunning ustiga uning qiymatini (sonini) yozamiz
  geom_text(
    stat = 'count', 
    aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
    hjust = -0.2, # Matnni ustundan biroz o'ngga surish
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  
  # Grafik sarlavhalari va o'q nomlarini kiritamiz
  labs(
    x = "Уй хўжаликлари сони",
    y = "Туманлар"
  ) +
  
  # Orqa fonni va umumiy ko'rinishni chiroyli qilamiz
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) 

library(lubridate)

household_with_duration <- household_clean %>%
  # 1. Matn formatidagi vaqtni R tushunadigan sana-vaqt formatiga o'tkazamiz
  mutate(
    start_time = ymd_hms(start), # ymd_hms -> Year-Month-Day Hour-Minute-Second
    end_time = ymd_hms(end)
  ) %>%
  
  # 2. Boshlanish va tugash vaqtlari orasidagi farqni daqiqalarda hisoblaymiz
  mutate(
    duration_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Ma'lumotlarni tozalash: Mantiqqa zid qiymatlarni (masalan, 1 daqiqadan kam 
  # yoki 3 soatdan (180 daqiqa) ko'p) olib tashlash tahlil sifatini oshiradi.
  filter(duration_minutes >= 1 & duration_minutes <= 180)


household_with_duration %>%
  summarise(
    `Ўртача давомийлик (дақиқа)` = mean(duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Медиана давомийлик (дақиқа)` = median(duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Минимал вақт (дақиқа)` = min(duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Максимал вақт (дақиқа)` = max(duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_header(title = "So'rovnomaga sarflangan vaqtning umumiy ko'rsatkichlari")


household_with_duration %>%
  # Eng tez bajarilgan 5 ta so'rovnomani tanlab olamiz
  slice_min(order_by = duration_minutes, n = 10) %>%
  # Kerakli ustunlarni chiroyli nomlar bi lan tanlab olamiz
  select(
    `ID` = `id`,
    `Interviewer raqami` = Interviewer_id,
    `Давомийлиги (дақиқа)` = duration_minutes,
    `UX azolari soni` = hh_member_count
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Eng tez bajarilgan so'rovnomalar")

household_with_duration %>%
  # Eng tez bajarilgan 5 ta so'rovnomani tanlab olamiz
  slice_max(order_by = duration_minutes, n = 10) %>%
  # Kerakli ustunlarni chiroyli nomlar bi lan tanlab olamiz
  select(
    `ID` = `id`,
    `Interviewer raqami` = Interviewer_id,
    `Давомийлиги (дақиқа)` = duration_minutes,
    `UX azolari soni` = hh_member_count
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Eng uzoq bajarilgan so'rovnomalar")



missing_geopoint_data <- household_clean %>%
  
  # 1. `is.na()` funksiyasi yordamida geopoint ustuni bo'sh (NA) bo'lgan qatorlarni filtrlaymiz
  filter(is.na(`start-geopoint`)) %>%
  
  # 2. Kerakli ustunlarni tanlab olamiz
  select(
    `So'rovnoma ID` = `id`,
    `Intervyuer ID` = Interviewer_id,
    `Yuborilgan vaqt` = `_submission_time`
  )

# Natijani chiroyli jadval ko'rinishida chiqaramiz
  # Agar geopozitsiyasi yo'q anketalar topilsa, jadvalni ko'rsatamiz
  missing_geopoint_data %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title = "Geopozitsiyasi yoqilmagan So'rovnomalar",
      subtitle = "Ma'lumotlar sifatini tekshirish uchun"
    )
```
